mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_account (principal_key, tenant_key, available_cash, total_assets, updated_at) values (#{principalKey}, #{tenantKey}, coalesce(#{availableCash}, 0), #{totalAssets}, #{updatedAt}) on conflict (principal_key, tenant_key) where deleted_at is null do update set total_assets = excluded.total_assets, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
